prompt_head:
Role: Configuration Specialist II at CentralReach
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 1–3 years of experience in a technical configuration, impleme

assessments.note: About 4 years of technical implementation and onboarding work at Linkme, which meets the 1-3 year requirement.
Shows attention to detail through validation pipelines and onboarding blueprints, but no evidence of concurrent task management.
Client-facing onboarding is shown, but cross-functional work with Implementation, Product, and Engineering is not explicit.
Built and deployed systems, but no evidence of resolving complex configuration issues with limited guidance.
Backend validation and agent workflow configuration shown, but translating business requirements into AI rule settings is not explicit.
Client onboarding and an operations CRM are shown, but direct customer account provisioning across systems is not.
No evidence of autism/IDD care software or ABA therapy domain experience.

output.verdict_line: The candidate has relevant systems and onboarding experience and meets the years requirement, but several configuration and cross-functional items are only partly shown and there is no ABA or IDD domain experience.
top_gaps: Experience with autism/IDD care software or ABA therapy domain
Cross-functional coordination with Implementation, Product, and Engineering teams
Provisioning and configuring customer accounts across internal systems with minimal oversight
